guard: who lists agents with their presence metadata, hides infrastructure endpoints unless --all, keeps condition rows under --waiting, reports managed only from a manager's answer, a census it could not read as partial and a scoped answer as a label, refuses a roster it may not read, and whoami reports each grant state with a ledger elsewhere as partial
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/who-roster.smoke.ts
why: The suite drives the built binary, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.
The managed decision and the user-auth grant states are imported from source in process, so those mutations are read without the build.
The remote-login cells drive the built binary with a real remote registration and cached login through the native auth provider. They do not invent an owner field the provider does not return.

mutations.name: infrastructure endpoints are listed by default
mutations.expectRed: every agent is listed and the infrastructure endpoint is not
mutations.cell: every agent is listed and the infrastructure endpoint is not

mutations.name: --waiting drops a row that reports a condition
mutations.expectRed: --waiting keeps the waiting row and the row with a condition
mutations.cell: --waiting keeps the waiting row and the row with a condition

mutations.name: the harness is read from a key presence does not carry
mutations.expectRed: harness, model and host come from the presence metadata
mutations.cell: harness, model and host come from the presence metadata

mutations.name: a census that could not be read says no seat is managed
mutations.expectRed: the warning names the unread census and every agent's managed is unknown
mutations.cell: the warning names the unread census and every agent's managed is unknown

mutations.name: a census that could not be read is not a warning
mutations.find: warnings.push({ code: "MANAGERS_UNREAD", target, message: `could not ask the managers which seats they run: ${failure.message}` });
mutations.expectRed: a manager that does not answer makes who partial with exit 4
mutations.cell: a manager that does not answer makes who partial with exit 4

mutations.name: a roster the identity may not read is not classified as denied
mutations.expectRed: a credential that may not read presence is a PERMISSION_DENIED refusal, exit 2, not an empty roster
mutations.cell: a credential that may not read presence is a PERMISSION_DENIED refusal, exit 2, not an empty roster

mutations.name: an incomplete census says an unlisted seat is not managed
mutations.expectRed: an incomplete census can only say a listed seat is managed
mutations.cell: an incomplete census can only say a listed seat is managed

mutations.name: one manager's answer is not labeled as covering only its own seats
mutations.expectRed: one manager's answer leaves other seats unknown and says so
mutations.cell: one manager's answer leaves other seats unknown and says so

mutations.name: a grant ledger on another machine reads as complete
mutations.expectRed: a grant ledger on another machine is a partial read, exit 4
mutations.cell: a grant ledger on another machine is a partial read, exit 4

mutations.name: a signed-in user without a grant is read as a remote ledger
mutations.expectRed: a signed-in user without a grant reads and posts nothing
mutations.cell: a signed-in user without a grant reads and posts nothing

mutations.name: a signer's identity is reported as an open mesh
mutations.expectRed: whoami on a signer's mesh is one complete envelope naming the signer
mutations.cell: whoami on a signer's mesh is one complete envelope naming the signer

mutations.name: a scoped census answer is counted as a part left unread
mutations.expectRed: that answer is a label, not a part left unread
mutations.cell: that answer is a label, not a part left unread

mutations.name: a cached remote login needs a locally derivable owner to count as signed in
mutations.replace: const signedIn = st.login !== undefined && st.owner !== undefined;
mutations.expectRed: the native remote provider leaves a logged-in user's grant unknown, not empty
mutations.cell: the native remote provider leaves a logged-in user's grant unknown, not empty

mutations.name: an unsigned user identity is called a cached login
mutations.expectRed: a remote registration without a cached login says not signed in
mutations.cell: a remote registration without a cached login says not signed in

mutations.name: a remote login with an unknown principal is called signed out
mutations.find: text: id.subject ? "not known on this machine" : "not signed in",
mutations.expectRed: a cached remote login with no locally derivable principal is not called signed out
mutations.cell: a cached remote login with no locally derivable principal is not called signed out

mutations.name: a remote login with an unknown principal is told to sign in again
mutations.expectRed: a cached remote login with no locally derivable principal is not called signed out
mutations.cell: a cached remote login with no locally derivable principal is not called signed out

mutations.name: whoami refreshes a remote catalog before its offline read
mutations.expectRed: whoami stays offline with a cached login and an uncached catalog
mutations.cell: whoami stays offline with a cached login and an uncached catalog
